limitations: Current mutable rows do not establish original historically known values.
Each query is a separate receipt, not an atomic database snapshot.
Team calendar denominator is schedule-based; game finality not certified.
Source payload hashes are database-reported, not recomputed from full raw payloads.

receipts.query: select table_name,jsonb_object_agg(column_name,data_type) columns from information_schema.columns where table_schema='public' and table_name in ('nst_gamelog_pk_counts','nst_gamelog_es_counts','nst_gamelog_pp_counts','nst_gamelog_as_counts','nst_team_gamelogs_pk_counts','rolling_player_game_metrics','skatersGameStats','nhl_api_game_payloads_raw','gamelog_game_map','wgo_skater_stats','team_games') group by table_name order by table_name

select player_id,date,season_id,game_id,team_abbrev,games_played,goals,assists,shots,ev_goals,ev_points,pp_goals,pp_assists,pp_shots,sh_goals,sh_assists,sh_shots,toi_per_game,ev_time_on_ice,pp_toi,sh_time_on_ice from public.wgo_skater_stats where player_id in (8478402,8476453,8477939) and date >= '2026-03-01' and date < '2026-10-02' order by player_id,date desc limit 18

select 'pk' strength,player_id,date_scraped,season,gp,toi,goals,total_assists,shots,created_at from public.nst_gamelog_pk_counts where player_id in (8478402,8476453,8477939) and date_scraped >= '2026-03-01' and date_scraped < '2026-10-02' union all select 'ev',player_id,date_scraped,season,gp,toi,goals,total_assists,shots,created_at from public.nst_gamelog_es_counts where player_id in (8478402,8476453,8477939) and date_scraped >= '2026-03-01' and date_scraped < '2026-10-02' order by player_id,date_scraped desc,strength limit 36

select team_abbreviation,date,season_id,gp,toi_seconds,toi_per_gp_seconds,sf,gf,created_at,updated_at from public.nst_team_gamelogs_pk_counts where team_abbreviation in ('TBL','TOR','UTA') and date >= '2026-09-20' and date < '2026-10-02' order by date desc,team_abbreviation limit 15

with w as (select * from public.wgo_skater_stats where player_id in (8478402,8476453,8477939) and date >= '2026-03-01' and date < '2026-04-16' and season_id=20252026 and games_played=1)
select w.player_id,count(*) appearances,count(*) filter(where w.sh_time_on_ice>0) pk_exposed,count(*) filter(where p.id is not null) nst_pk_rows,count(*) filter(where w.sh_time_on_ice>0 and p.id is null) exposed_missing_nst,count(*) filter(where w.sh_time_on_ice=0 and p.id is null) zero_exposure_nst_absent,count(*) filter(where w.sh_time_on_ice is null or w.sh_goals is null or w.sh_assists is null or w.sh_shots is null) wgo_pk_missing,count(*) filter(where p.id is not null and (p.toi<>w.sh_time_on_ice or p.goals<>w.sh_goals or p.total_assists<>w.sh_assists or p.shots<>w.sh_shots)) pk_disagreements,count(*) filter(where w.goals<>w.ev_goals+w.pp_goals+w.sh_goals or w.assists<>w.ev_points-w.ev_goals+w.pp_assists+w.sh_assists) goal_assist_partition_mismatch,count(*) filter(where w.toi_per_game<>w.ev_time_on_ice+w.pp_toi+w.sh_time_on_ice) wgo_toi_partition_mismatch,count(*) filter(where a.id is not null and e.id is not null and pp.id is not null and p.id is not null and (a.toi<>e.toi+pp.toi+p.toi or a.shots<>e.shots+pp.shots+p.shots or a.goals<>e.goals+pp.goals+p.goals or a.total_assists<>e.total_assists+pp.total_assists+p.total_assists)) nst_partition_mismatch,count(*) filter(where a.id is not null and e.id is not null and pp.id is not null and p.id is not null) nst_four_rows,count(*) filter(where g.id is null or g.date<>w.date or g."seasonId"<>w.season_id or g.type<>2) game_binding_fail,count(*) filter(where p.created_at>'2026-04-16T00:00:00Z') nst_pk_created_after_historical_cutoff from w left join public.nst_gamelog_pk_counts p on p.player_id=w.player_id and p.date_scraped=w.date and p.season=w.season_id left join public.nst_gamelog_es_counts e on e.player_id=w.player_id and e.date_scraped=w.date and e.season=w.season_id left join public.nst_gamelog_pp_counts pp on pp.player_id=w.player_id and pp.date_scraped=w.date and pp.season=w.season_id left join public.nst_gamelog_as_counts a on a.player_id=w.player_id and a.date_scraped=w.date and a.season=w.season_id left join public.games g on g.id=w.game_id group by w.player_id order by w.player_id

select strength_state,count(*) n,min(game_date),max(game_date),count(*) filter(where toi_seconds_total_all is null or goals_total_all is null or assists_total_all is null or shots_total_all is null) incomplete from public.rolling_player_game_metrics where player_id in (8478402,8476453,8477939) and game_date >= '2026-09-20' and game_date < '2026-10-02' group by strength_state order by strength_state

select team_abbreviation,count(*) n,min(date),max(date),count(*) filter(where toi_seconds is null or sf is null or gf is null) missing,count(*) filter(where toi_seconds=0) zero_toi from public.nst_team_gamelogs_pk_counts where team_abbreviation in ('TBL','TOR','UTA') and date >= '2026-03-01' and date < '2026-04-16' group by team_abbreviation order by team_abbreviation

select w.player_id,w.date,w.game_id,w.sh_time_on_ice,w.sh_goals,w.sh_assists,w.sh_shots,p.toi,p.goals,p.total_assists,p.shots,p.created_at from public.wgo_skater_stats w join public.nst_gamelog_pk_counts p on p.player_id=w.player_id and p.date_scraped=w.date and p.season=w.season_id where w.player_id in (8478402,8476453,8477939) and w.date >= '2026-03-01' and w.date < '2026-04-16' and (p.toi<>w.sh_time_on_ice or p.goals<>w.sh_goals or p.total_assists<>w.sh_assists or p.shots<>w.sh_shots or p.created_at>'2026-04-16T00:00:00Z') order by w.player_id,w.date limit 8

select e.player_id,e.date_scraped,e.toi ev_toi,f.toi five_toi,e.goals ev_goals,f.goals five_goals,e.shots ev_shots,f.shots five_shots,w.ev_time_on_ice,w.toi_per_game_5v5 from public.nst_gamelog_es_counts e join public.nst_gamelog_5v5_counts f on f.player_id=e.player_id and f.date_scraped=e.date_scraped and f.season=e.season left join public.wgo_skater_stats w on w.player_id=e.player_id and w.date=e.date_scraped where e.player_id=8476453 and e.date_scraped >= '2026-03-01' and e.date_scraped < '2026-04-16' and e.toi<>f.toi order by e.date_scraped desc limit 5
select * from public.team_franchise_alias where abbrev in ('TBL','TOR','UTA','ARI','PHX') order by abbrev,season_start

select player_id,date_scraped,season,gp,toi,goals,total_assists,shots,created_at from public.nst_gamelog_pk_counts where player_id in (8478402,8476453,8477939) and date_scraped >= '2026-09-20' and date_scraped < '2026-10-02' order by player_id,date_scraped limit 12

select table_name,column_name,data_type from information_schema.columns where table_schema='public' and table_name in ('teams','forge_team_game_strength','forge_input_snapshots') and (table_name='teams' or column_name in ('team_id','game_id','game_date','toi_pk_seconds','shots_pk','source','created_at','updated_at','payload','payload_hash')) order by table_name,column_name
select t.id,t.name,t.abbreviation from public.teams t where trim(t.abbreviation) in ('TBL','TOR','UTA','ARI','PHX') order by t.abbreviation,t.id

select 'player' scope,player_id entity,count(*) rows,min(game_date),max(game_date),count(*) filter(where toi_pk_seconds is null or shots_pk is null) missing_pk,count(*) filter(where toi_pk_seconds=0) zero_pk from public.forge_player_game_strength where player_id in (8478402,8476453,8477939) and game_date >= '2026-03-01' and game_date < '2026-04-16' group by player_id union all select 'team',team_id,count(*),min(game_date),max(game_date),count(*) filter(where toi_pk_seconds is null or shots_pk is null),count(*) filter(where toi_pk_seconds=0) from public.forge_team_game_strength where team_id in (14,10,68) and game_date >= '2026-03-01' and game_date < '2026-04-16' group by team_id order by scope,entity

select t.id,t.abbreviation,count(*) eligible_calendar_games,count(n.id) nst_pk_matches,count(*) filter(where n.id is null) missing_dates from public.games g cross join public.teams t left join public.nst_team_gamelogs_pk_counts n on n.team_abbreviation=trim(t.abbreviation) and n.date=g.date and n.season_id=g."seasonId" where t.id in (14,10,68) and g.date >= '2026-03-01' and g.date < '2026-04-16' and g.type=2 and g."seasonId"=20252026 and t.id in (g."homeTeamId",g."awayTeamId") group by t.id,t.abbreviation order by t.id

select player_id,count(*) n,count(*) filter(where created_at<='2026-04-16T00:00:00Z') first_insert_before_cutoff,count(*) filter(where created_at>'2026-04-16T00:00:00Z') first_insert_after_cutoff,sum(toi) exposure_sec,sum(goals) g,sum(total_assists) a,sum(shots) s from public.nst_gamelog_pk_counts where player_id in (8478402,8476453,8477939) and date_scraped >= '2026-03-01' and date_scraped < '2026-04-16' and season=20252026 group by player_id order by player_id

select s.player_id,s.game_date,s.game_id,s.team_id,s.toi_pk_seconds,s.shots_pk,w.sh_time_on_ice,w.sh_shots,p.toi nst_pk_toi,p.shots nst_pk_shots,s.created_at,s.updated_at from public.forge_player_game_strength s left join public.wgo_skater_stats w on w.player_id=s.player_id and w.date=s.game_date left join public.nst_gamelog_pk_counts p on p.player_id=s.player_id and p.date_scraped=s.game_date where s.player_id in (8478402,8476453,8477939) and s.game_date >= '2026-03-01' and s.game_date < '2026-04-16' order by s.player_id,s.game_date

select game_id,endpoint,count(*) rows,min(fetched_at) first_retained_fetch,max(fetched_at) last_retained_fetch,jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('id',id,'hash',payload_hash,'fetchedAt',fetched_at,'state',payload->>'gameState') order by fetched_at) receipts from public.nhl_api_game_payloads_raw where game_id in (2025020967,2025021176,2025021109,2026020010) group by game_id,endpoint order by game_id,endpoint

select f.team_id,f.game_date,f.toi_pk_seconds player_seconds,n.toi_seconds nst_team_clock_seconds,f.shots_pk,n.sf nst_shots from public.forge_team_game_strength f join public.teams t on t.id=f.team_id left join public.nst_team_gamelogs_pk_counts n on n.team_abbreviation=trim(t.abbreviation) and n.date=f.game_date where f.team_id in (14,10,68) and f.game_date >= '2026-03-14' and f.game_date < '2026-03-20' order by f.team_id,f.game_date

select r.game_id,r.id,r.fetched_at,p->>'eventId' event_id,p->>'typeDescKey' event_type,p->>'situationCode' situation_code,p->'details'->>'eventOwnerTeamId' event_team,p->'details'->>'shootingPlayerId' shooter,p->'details'->>'scoringPlayerId' scorer from public.nhl_api_game_payloads_raw r cross join lateral jsonb_array_elements(r.payload->'plays') p where r.game_id in (2025021109,2025021076) and r.endpoint='play-by-play' and p->>'typeDescKey' in ('goal','shot-on-goal') and (p->'details'->>'shootingPlayerId'='8476453' or p->'details'->>'scoringPlayerId'='8476453') order by r.game_id,p->>'eventId' limit 16
select id,date,"seasonId",type,"homeTeamId","awayTeamId" from public.games where id in (2025021076,2025021109,2025020967,2025021176,2026020010) order by id
select r.id,r.game_id,r.payload_hash,r.fetched_at,r.payload->'plays'->0->>'situationCode' first_situation from public.nhl_api_game_payloads_raw r where r.id in (596,472)
